purpose: Independent exact-commit reconstruction of every indexed closed Windows outer original; no builds/tests or source/evidence modification.
required_checks: Index, release ZIP, and every additional original match the exact commit Git blobs byte for byte.
Every indexed original has exact manifest bytes/hash/mode and a recoverable committed source.
Reconstruct every indexed relative path without executing recovered content; restore and verify original mode.
Producer manifest membership, 198 record hashes, original/restored file sets, and original source before/after inventory match.
scope_limits: Local Git object and working-copy identity; no external GitHub fetch/publication verification.
Recovery correctness only; no compiler, runtime, benchmark, speed, or Elo conclusion.
